name: NPS Metals
old_description: NPS Metals Proudly Services all of North Dakota, South Dakota & Minnesota
about:
NPS Metals operates from Fargo, North Dakota, serving customers across North Dakota, South Dakota, and Minnesota. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company provides light fabrication services including laser cutting, plasma cutting, CNC forming, and machining. Its facility warehouses several thousand tons of steel in a wide variety of sizes, shapes, and grades, offering inventory support alongside fabrication.

NPS Metals serves industrial customers throughout the Upper Midwest, though specific industry sectors are not detailed in its public materials.

The company highlights its ISO 9001:2015 registration, noting that implementation of the standard has improved processes, increased access to international markets, reduced customer audits, and improved profitability.
